flags.message: Frozen band is `baseline` (sal-v4), but the petitioner is the United States: caption "U.S. Doge Service, et al." with the Solicitor General as counsel of record and OMB, its Director, NARA and the Archivist as co-petitioners. Under the salience scorer's stated caption rule this is a `federal` petitioner. The federal-column pooled `reached` rate (OT2017-OT2024) is roughly 73% against the baseline column's roughly 5%, so the skill yardstick this cell is scored against is probably the wrong class's floor. I anchored on the frozen `baseline` band as the prompt instructs and adjusted from it. Likely cause: the scorer's federal markers do not match "U.S. Doge Service", and the respondent caption "United States District Court" may have confused placement.

The petition appendix reproduces this Court's own June 6, 2025 order in the same dispute (No. 24-1246 / 24A1122: stay granted, certiorari granted, D.C. Circuit vacated and remanded, discovery stayed pending disposition of this petition). That is pre-snapshot, provisioned material and legitimate forward signal, but it is decisive for my number, so noting it here. I also carry general knowledge, not in the provisioned record, that the DOGE structure was reported wound down in late 2025; used only to shade the forecast downward.
